scope: single-model public mathematical review, targeted Q recovery, and repeated LU/U observations

findings.title: Formal statistical validity is not established
findings.evidence: A targeted recovery of the 11 frozen Q-v2 NOT_SCORED cases made 17 additional Kimi K2.5 calls, including 3 format retries. Independent audit passed; the recovery yielded PASS 1, INCONCLUSIVE 7, and NOT_SCORED 3. The original 92-case denominator remains unchanged. A separate public-only G6 CF3 boundary review covered all 138 rows using 23 public formula witnesses: 95 model actions aligned with the public witness and 43 did not. It used no private oracle and explicitly does not claim scientific release.
findings.remediation: Obtain an independent blinded truth set and domain-grade mathematical/statistical review. Keep targeted Q recovery separate from the frozen 92-case denominator and retain the 43 public-review failures.

findings.title: All eligible G6 public proof graphs have no dependency edges for G7 localization
findings.evidence: Three additional public-only LU/U replicate cohorts completed 33 real Kimi K2.5 calls: 1, 6, and 3 independently validated non-final state transitions respectively, with 23 no-state-change records. Together with the initial 11-call cohort, the four-batch aggregate is 44 calls, 13 observed transitions, and 31 no-state-change observations. Every batch passed independent graph/trace/model/isolation audits.
findings.remediation: Treat the 13 transitions as observed public model behavior only; obtain protocol-approved causal validation and retain all 31 no-change observations before making a U claim.

findings.title: G7 revalidation has trace lifecycle inconsistencies after append-only retry recovery
findings.evidence: No historical rows were edited. The 150/150-state, 72/72-checkpoint recovery and 13 valid retry-target traces remain separate from the 13 retained historical lifecycle failures.
findings.remediation: Keep historical failures and corrected retry traces separately audited; do not relabel the historical denominator as clean without a protocol-approved reanalysis.

test.evidence: Targeted tests passed after the new public review and Q recovery runner changes.
